# Cricket state fixtures

Fifty Cricsheet JSON matches (cricsheet.org, ODC-By; download of 2026-11-04), gzipped, otherwise untouched.
Chosen once by a fixed rule: men's matches with a winner and no D/L method, ordered by date, spread evenly over
each group's history: 20 IPL, 15 T20I (match type T20, international), 15 ODI. They test cricket/state/match_state.py
against the scorecard fields Cricsheet records apart from the ball-by-ball (the second-innings target, the result
margin): tests/test_cricket_state.py.
